description: An object literal holding a function handed to a host-JS call whose RESULT is kept as a scrml value fires E-VALUE-FUNCTION-STORED (§14.3). `Object.freeze({ double: twice })` bound to `ops` launders the function back into a scrml value; the host-boundary exemption holds only while the host call's result is not kept. Incidental W-PROGRAM-SPA-INFERRED is ignored by superset matching.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S464 "(a) Close it" (a host call's RESULT kept as a scrml value is judged)
rationale: §14.3 the host-boundary exemption for a literal written directly as a host-JS call argument holds ONLY when the call's result is not kept; a statement-position host call (`console.log({ f })`) stays legal.
